parts.text: In this experiment, you will determine the resistance of a lamp in different electrical circuits. Circuit 1 has been set up for you as shown in Fig. 3.1. Do not alter the connections of the lamp, voltmeter and ammeter between terminals X and Y during the whole experiment. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 3.1. Fig. 3.1

units all correct (V, A, Ω)
R calculations correct
V, I and R values all decreasing
2 or 3 sig. figs. in R column
